summary: Full backend+frontend testing for Boltlabs landing page. Backend: 6/6 pytest tests passed (POST/GET /api/contact happy path + 422 validation cases). Frontend: All 9 requested flows verified end-to-end via Playwright — hero headline+3D canvas, all nav-link smooth-scroll (services/faq/contact), 'Explore Our Universe' CTA scroll, FAQ accordion toggle open/close on faq-trigger-2, contact form empty validation toast, successful submit with clear+success toast, DB persistence verified via GET /api/contact, section visibility, and page wheel-scroll working (canvas does not block). Zero console errors / no WebGL or React crashes observed.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: /api/contact GET endpoint has no pagination or auth — fine for MVP but should be protected before production (currently publicly exposes all contact submissions).
Minor: EmailStr requires 'email-validator' package; confirm requirements.txt includes it (tests pass so it does).
Nit: Contact.jsx uses `${process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL}/api` — good, no hardcoded URLs.
seed_data_creation: Test contact records created with TEST_PW_ prefix
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use `wait_for_selector` on [data-testid=hero-3d-canvas] instead of networkidle (Three.js animation prevents network idle). Lenis smooth-scroll needs ~1.5-1.8s wait after nav click. Sonner toasts show/dismiss quickly — assert via document.body.innerText within 3.5s of submit. Backend GET /api/contact is public and returns all messages — helpful for verifying persistence.
